title: Identifying Latent Declarative Representations of Code for Assisting Repository Migration
abstract: arXiv:2608.23619v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Legacy software repositories embed decades of domain knowledge in undocumented code, making understanding and modernization difficult. We treat a program as the implementation of an unobserved, declarative description of its computation and investigate whether making this latent declarative representation explicit improves repository-scale porting. ADFD-Migrate approximates the latent representation with an annotated data-flow diagram (ADFD) of processes, data stores, external entities, flows, and behavioral contracts. An LLM infers the source ADFD from bounded repository context, guided by static-analysis coverage checks. Dependency-aware chunking orders bounded process groups for target-language generation. Differences between the source ADFD and a statically recovered target ADFD then guide regeneration. translated_title: 识别代码中潜在声明式表示以辅助仓库迁移
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23619v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：遗留软件仓库在未文档化的代码中嵌入了数十年的领域知识，使得理解和现代化变得困难。我们将程序视为其计算过程的未观察到的声明式描述的实现，并研究使这种潜在的声明式表示显式化是否能改善仓库规模的移植。ADFD-Migrate 通过带有注释的数据流图（ADFD）来近似这种潜在表示，该图包含进程、数据存储、外部实体、流程和行为契约。一个大型语言模型（LLM）在静态分析覆盖检查的引导下，从有限的仓库上下文中推断源 ADFD。依赖感知的分块对有限进程组进行排序，以进行目标语言生成。源 ADFD 与静态恢复的目标 ADFD 之间的差异随后指导重新生成。我们在 f2x50 上评估了 ADFD-Migrate，这是一个包含 50 个 Fortran 仓库的新基准，代码行数从 1.5k 到 1.6M 不等，并涵盖三种复杂度级别。
tldr: 本文提出ADFD-Migrate方法，通过利用大型语言模型和静态分析生成注释数据流图来显式化代码的潜在声明式表示，从而有效提升遗留仓库的跨语言迁移效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ADFD-Migrate, which leverages LLMs and static analysis to make latent declarative representations of code explicit via annotated data-flow diagrams, significantly improving repository-scale porting.
